neighbours.label: The ',' or ' and' that closes an open-ended list and points to further unnamed items (', and more', 'and other X', 'and many'), vs coordinators in closed lists or between two items; the negative pole takes the alternative closure ' etc' / 等
fire: The library offers books, films, music, and more for all ages.
The clinic employs surgeons, therapists and other health professionals.
Our blog covers travel, food, fashion, and much more.
The festival features jugglers, clowns, acrobats and many other performers.
The kit includes brushes, paints, canvases, and lots more.
Volunteers, donors and other supporters attended the gala.
The store stocks tents, stoves, boots and other camping gear.
Learn about history, science, art, and more in our free courses.
quiet: The library offers books and films on the first floor.
The clinic employs two surgeons and a therapist.
Our blog covers travel and food in southern Italy.
The festival features a juggler and a clown on Sunday.
The kit includes one brush and three tubes of paint.
Anna and her brother attended the gala.
The store sold the tent and the stove on Monday.
We studied history and science before lunch.

predictions: Lists ending 'and more', 'and other ...' or 'and many ...' reach 0.2-0.4 at the coordinator; closed lists of named items and two-item coordination stay under 0.1.
